moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Everyone I know at Nvidia wanted Jensen back and it shows
moments.why: Explosive response to Jensen Huang's reinstatement at Nvidia — huge viewership (~2.6M views) and hits a nerve in tech culture.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Those who violate the law on this platform WILL be prosecuted, WHEREVER they may be in the world.
moments.why: Bold enforcement stance from X’s owner — stirred massive engagement (~2.2M views) and debate among 25–45‑year‑olds on tech and free speech.

moments.author: P Polymarket
moments.quote: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei reportedly suggested immersive video games could pacify the masses left jobless by AI
moments.why: Shocking public strategy attributed to an AI CEO — raises ethical and socio‑economic concerns, going viral with millions of views and reactions.

moments.author: Pavel Durov
moments.quote: The least realistic thing about GTA VI is that Jason and Lucia run a whole criminal operation without a single Telegram group.
moments.why: Humorous take on GTA VI’s realism from a high‑profile tech founder — resonated broadly with gaming and tech fans, high virality.

moments.author: Bryan Johnson
moments.quote: riemann hypothesis is solved death is next
moments.why: Provocative, existential humor from a longevity millionaire — wildly popular within nerd culture and tech circles today.
